We need to fix imports. The test uses JUnit 5 (jupiter). The compilation environment likely doesn't have JUnit 5 or Mockito. We can replace with JUnit 4 imports (org.junit.*) which are likely available. Simpler: use JUnit 4 annotations: @BeforeClass, @Before, @Test from org.junit. Also assertions from org.junit.Assert.*. Remove Mockito and ExtendWith.

Also remove duplicate imports and NaN usage. They import org.ta4j.core.num.NaN and static import NaN.NaN. But they later use Num.NaN which may not exist. In ta4j, Num.NaN is a static method? Actually there is class org.ta4j.core.num.NaN extends Num? Not sure. Simpler: use DoubleNum.NaN? In library, DoubleNum has static NaN constant? Possibly DoubleNum.NaN. But we can avoid needing NaN: In test they compare expectedExit = Trade.sellAt(1, Num.NaN, Num.NaN); Instead we can use Trade.sellAt(1, DoubleNum.NaN, DoubleNum.NaN) assuming static field. If not, we can just use Trade.sellAt(1, DoubleNum.valueOf(Double.NaN), DoubleNum.valueOf(Double.NaN)). Simpler: use DoubleNum.valueOf(Double.NaN). So modify.

Also imports for Num not needed except DoubleNum.

Remove unused imports.

Now adjust code accordingly.

Let's produce corrected test class.
